prompt:
Write the file `prisma/schema.prisma` for the repository "booking-saas".

Stack: Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe
Purpose of this file: models for Studio, ClassSession, Booking and Membership with a studioId on each
Project context: A white-label class booking app where each studio gets its own subdomain, timetable and memberships.

Requirements:
- 25 to 70 lines of realistic, plausible code in the right language for the file extension.
- A few short comments, no long docstrings, no secrets or real credentials.
- Output only the file contents, without Markdown fences.
text:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Studio {
  id          String         @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  slug        String         @unique
  subdomain   String         @unique
  createdAt   DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime       @updatedAt
  classSessions ClassSession[]
  bookings    Booking[]
  memberships Membership[]
}

model ClassSession {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  studioId    String
  studio      Studio    @relation(fields: [studioId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title       String
  startsAt    DateTime
  endsAt      DateTime
  capacity    Int
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  bookings    Booking[]

  @@index([studioId, startsAt])
}

model Booking {
  id            String      @id @default(cuid())
  studioId      String
  studio        Studio      @relation(fields: [studioId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  classSessionId String
  classSession  ClassSession @relation(fields: [classSessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  customerEmail String
  status        String      @default("confirmed")
  stripePaymentIntentId String? @unique
  createdAt     DateTime    @default(now())

  @@index([studioId, classSessionId])
}

model Membership {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  studioId      String
  studio        Studio   @relation(fields: [studioId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name          String
  stripePriceId String   @unique
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([studioId, isActive])
}
